meta.title: Persona Bridge
meta.description: Three bridges between the persona and the outside: virtual, game, info. Every bridge must take input to output and turn output back into input; session bridges only change context through the conversation, non-session bridges let an outside program adjust context by writing files.

tools.bridge_status: Read-only: three bridges, their modes, ledger counts and feedback coverage.
tools.bridge_send: Take one external input, translate it into a plan, and write it into the bridge ledger as in.
tools.bridge_pull: Read the inbox of a non-session bridge (files written by the outside program) and record them as input.
tools.bridge_feedback: Record what actually came out, so input and output can be compared.
tools.bridge_mode: Set a bridge to session (context only through conversation) or nonsession (context adjusted by an outside program).
tools.bridge_trigger: Bridge triggers: output feeds input and input self-triggers; op=status to read, op=fire to step once
